source_snapshot.test_name_items: All SSD NVMe LED Check - Present
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if present LED function works normally

1. Insert NVMe SSD into BP slot and check present LED

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Check system spec define LED function

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: storcli/sas3ircu/ssacli (RAID/HBA tool) or ipmitool for BMC LED
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Unverified raw IPMI command plus lsblk device list.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; acknowledges operator observation but supplies an unverified platform raw command that may control rather than read the LED.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; requires LED specification, exact bay/SSD mapping, supported read-only tool and operator proof.
historical_reviews.round_02: No separate exact-code round-02 entry was found.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No V3/V3.1 baseline record exists; exact source and V2 were independently reviewed.

original_test_intent: Verify by physical observation that inserting the approved NVMe SSD into each intended backplane bay produces the platform-defined present/power LED state for that bay, with device identity and management status used only as correlation.
original_method: A qualified operator maps the SSD serial and bay, follows the safe insertion procedure, inserts the drive and visually records the present LED color/state/timing against the chassis specification; the agent may collect target-bound read-only device and management status plus logs.
manual_activity: Physical SSD insertion and visual confirmation of the actual chassis/backplane present LED are the core stimulus and acceptance. The agent can collect correlated status but cannot see or claim the LED behavior, so the complete case is MANUAL ONLY.
required_inputs: Exact chassis/backplane/bay, NVMe SSD serial/model and carrier mapping
Platform specification for present LED applicability, color, steady/blink state and transition timing
Approved powered-off or hot-swap insertion procedure and workload/data safety
Qualified operator and required photo/video/checklist evidence
Supported read-only controller/BMC status command and device identity mapping
safety_requirements: Do not insert into a live bay unless the platform, controller and workload explicitly support that hot-swap action.
Verify bay/serial/carrier orientation and stop on resistance, connector/latch damage, power fault or unexpected storage state.
Do not run the unverified raw IPMI command; its platform meaning and read-versus-control semantics are unknown.
Preserve physical and management mismatches; do not auto-toggle LEDs, reseat drives or retry.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare the bay/serial/expected-LED matrix and validate the read-only status method.
Collect timestamped, target-bound inventory/management/log evidence around the operator insertion.
Correlate operator photos/video with device status and report Tool Result without claiming physical observation or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve insertion/hot-swap scope and define the expected present LED semantics from the platform specification.
Perform and attest the physical insertion and LED observation for each in-scope bay.
Resolve any LED/status mismatch and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The raw `0x3a 0x0e...` command is not documented for this platform and may change LED state; it is rejected. `lsblk` can correlate device presence but cannot prove physical LED output.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain operator visual inspection. Use only an owner-validated read-only controller/BMC status query and target-filtered device inventory as supplemental evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: SSD insertion, present LED check and 15/8-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: MANUAL LED OBSERVATION WITH TIME-CORRELATED READ-ONLY STATUS
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a per-bay manifest and synchronized operator video/photo showing insertion and LED transition, correlated with SSD serial enumeration and an approved read-only presence status/event.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/backplane, controller/BMC firmware, SSD firmware, OS and status-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project chassis/backplane LED specification and supported management-command documentation must be supplied.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact LED semantics and correlation without replacing visual acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; physical present LED behavior remains mandatory.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: LED specification, bay mapping and read-only status method.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A management bit or device enumeration cannot prove LED color, brightness, location or emitted state.

project_override_considerations: A project may mark bays or LED functions not applicable only with chassis specification evidence. Each tested bay must retain its own SSD identity and visual evidence.
expected_evidence: Chassis/backplane/bay/SSD map, LED specification, service-mode approval and operator identity
Operator-attributed timestamped insertion and present-LED photo/video for each tested bay
Correlated read-only device/management status and relevant system/BMC events
Any mismatch or N/A rationale, final safe state, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion consistently defer expected present-LED behavior to the platform specification. The absence of the specification is a readiness input, not a source contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The physical LED-validation intent is clear. Missing LED spec/mapping/operator are readiness inputs; the human visual core is MANUAL ONLY.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains operator confirmation but rejects the unverified raw command and PARTIAL label.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains mapping/spec/tool gates while applying the locked MANUAL ONLY rule for physical LED observation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Defines color/state/timing evidence, per-bay traceability and an explicit read-only command boundary.

review_improvement: Prevents an unsupported raw command or device list from being misreported as proof of a physical present LED and creates auditable per-bay evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source's criterion is the emitted physical LED behavior after a physical insertion. Both require a human operator/observer; status queries are non-equivalent supplements. Therefore MANUAL ONLY is the correct full-case classification.

no_automatic_retry: Do not reseat, toggle or rerun an unsupported command after abnormal LED behavior. Preserve the observation and wait for owner-directed inspection.
